injuries.name: CJ McCollum
injuries.detail: McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

injuries.name: Jock Landale
injuries.detail: Landale (hip) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.

injuries.name: Asa Newell
injuries.detail: Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.detail: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Nolan Traore
injuries.detail: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Moritz Wagner
injuries.detail: Wagner (knee) won't be available for Friday's game against Toronto.

injuries.name: Mitchell Robinson
injuries.detail: Robinson has been ruled out Marc D'Amico of the Celtics' official sitefor Friday's game.

injuries.name: Kyrie Irving
injuries.detail: Irving (knee) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Suns due to left knee injury management.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.detail: Lively (foot) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.detail: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: Tobi Lawal
injuries.detail: Lawal (groin) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.detail: Biberovic (heel) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: Cade Cunningham
injuries.detail: Cunningham (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Duncan Robinson
injuries.detail: Robinson (quadriceps) is out for Friday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.detail: Detroit recalled Duren (hamstring) from the G League's Motor City Cruise on Wednesday.

injuries.name: Taurean Prince
injuries.detail: Prince underwent arthroscopic right knee surgery Nov. 18 and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Ebuka Okorie
injuries.detail: The Pistons announced Tuesday that Okorie (oblique) will miss at least two weeks, per Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Stephen Curry
injuries.detail: Curry (abdomen) will be re-evaluated Friday after Thanksgiving, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.detail: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
injuries.detail: Haliburton (hamstring) has been ruled out per Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com for Friday's game against the 76ers. The guard participated in practice activities earlier this week as he continues working toward his return.

injuries.name: Kelly Oubre Jr.
injuries.detail: Oubre is questionable for Friday's game against the 76ers due to a right hand laceration.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.detail: McConnell (hamstring) is questionable for Friday's game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Larry Nance Jr.
injuries.detail: Nance (ankle) is probable for Friday's game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Cameron Boozer
injuries.detail: Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Jerami Grant
injuries.detail: Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.

injuries.name: Zach Edey
injuries.detail: Edey (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the Timberwolves.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.detail: Pippen (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Isaiah Stewart
injuries.detail: Stewart is questionable for Friday's game against the Timberwolves due to right hip soreness.

injuries.name: GG Jackson
injuries.detail: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

injuries.name: Richie Saunders
injuries.detail: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Kasparas Jakucionis
injuries.detail: Jakucionis (ankle) won't play Friday's game against the Pistons.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.detail: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: LaMelo Ball
injuries.detail: Ball (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies. The guard was previously questionable after spraining his left ankle during Wednesday's win over Oklahoma City.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) has been cleared for team basketball activities and is targeting a return to game action in January, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jaylen Clark
injuries.detail: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

injuries.name: Dejounte Murray
injuries.detail: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Bennedict Mathurin
injuries.detail: Mathurin (foot) is doubtful for Friday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Julian Reese
injuries.detail: The Pelicans transferred Reese from the G League's Laketown Squadron, and he will be available for New Orleans' game against the Warriors on Monday.

injuries.name: Trendon Watford
injuries.detail: Watford (ankle) is probable for Friday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: OG Anunoby
injuries.detail: Anunoby (calf) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Heat. The forward was previously listed as doubtful and will miss his third consecutive contest due to a left calf strain.

injuries.name: Karl-Anthony Towns
injuries.detail: Towns is questionable for Friday's game against the Heat due to a right abdominal contusion.

injuries.name: Miles McBride
injuries.detail: McBride (groin) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: Andre Drummond
injuries.detail: Drummond (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: Jordan Clarkson
injuries.detail: Clarkson (foot) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: Joel Embiid
injuries.detail: Embiid (illness) was at shootaround for the 76ers on Friday, Chris Hine of The Philly Inquirer reports.

injuries.name: Jaylen Brown
injuries.detail: Brown (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Damian Lillard
injuries.detail: Lillard (calf) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors. The veteran guard is dealing with right calf tightness and soreness.

injuries.name: Ja Morant
injuries.detail: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.detail: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries.detail: Youngblood (heel) is out for Friday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.detail: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

injuries.name: Dylan Harper
injuries.detail: Harper (hip) participated in Friday's morning shootaround, per Matt Guzman of SI.com.

injuries.name: De'Aaron Fox
injuries.detail: Fox (shin) is questionable for Friday's game against the Lakers.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: RJ Barrett
injuries.detail: Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.detail: Leonard has begun individual on-court workouts following treatment to address swelling in his left knee, and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Alijah Martin
injuries.detail: Martin is questionable for Friday's game against the Nets due to left knee soreness.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.detail: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bucks, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Lauri Markkanen
injuries.detail: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.detail: Nurkic (foot) is questionable for Friday's game against the Nuggets.

injuries.name: Jaxson Hayes
injuries.detail: Hayes (knee) is questionable for Friday's game against the Nuggets.

injuries.name: Mo Bamba
injuries.detail: Bamba (illness) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Nuggets, according to the Jazz's injury report.
